vi.R: Sa-lô-môn mất hai mươi năm để xây đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và cung điện của mình.

ko.B: 솔로몬이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집과 자기 궁전을 짓는 데 걸린 20년이 지나자,
ko.R: 솔로몬이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전과 자기 왕궁을 짓는 데 20년이 걸렸다.

pt.L: E aconteceu, ao fim de vinte anos, em que Salomão tinha construído a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e a sua casa,
pt.B: Ao fim dos vinte anos que Salomão levou para construir a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e o seu próprio palácio,
pt.R: Salomão levou vinte anos para construir o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e o seu próprio palácio.

decisions.choice: parallel to 1 Kings 9:10, with "his own house" for "the two houses, the house of the LORD and the house of the king"
decisions.reason: Chapter 8 retells 1 Kings 9:10-28. This verse matches 1 Kings 9:10 except that it says "his own house" where Kings names "the two houses" and calls the second "the house of the king". Both mean the temple and the royal palace.

decisions.choice: twenty years: seven for the temple and thirteen for the palace
decisions.reason: The temple took seven years (1 Kings 6:38) and the palace thirteen (1 Kings 7:1), so the whole building program lasted twenty years. Chronicles tells only of the temple (chapters 3-7) and assumes the palace (2:11; 7:11).

decisions.choice: a time clause that runs on into verse 2
decisions.reason: The sentence begins here and reaches its main statement in verse 2, "Solomon rebuilt them".

decisions.choice: It took Solomon twenty years ...
decisions.reason: Readable makes the time clause a sentence of its own, as in 1 Kings 9:10, and starts verse 2 with "Then".

decisions.choice: wording of 1 Kings 9:10 kept, with "su casa"
decisions.reason: Chapter 8 retells 1 Kings 9:10-28 (meaning decision); the Spanish Kings wording is kept at each level wherever the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: The time clause runs on into verse 2 ("...끝났을 때에,")
decisions.reason: As the English Literal and Balanced; Readable makes it a sentence. Years in figures (20년), as in 1 Kings.

decisions.choice: The Portuguese of 1 Kings 9:10-28, level by level, for this chapter; a sua casa (L), o seu próprio palácio (B, R)
decisions.reason: Chapter 8 retells 1 Kings 9:10-28 (m1), so each verse keeps the Portuguese of its parallel where the Hebrew is the same and changes only what Chronicles changes; here "a sua casa" takes the place of Kings' "as duas casas". The king's house is "o palácio" at Balanced and Readable, as in 7:11.

source.text: וְהֶעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן חוּרָם֙ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה בָּנָ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה אֹתָ֑ם וַיּ֥וֹשֶׁב שָׁ֖ם אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: and the cities which had given Huram to Solomon, built Solomon them and settled there [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: the cities that Huram had given to Solomon, Solomon built them, and settled the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel there.
en.B: Solomon rebuilt the towns that Huram had given him and settled {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} in them.
en.R: Then Solomon rebuilt the towns that Huram had given him, and he had {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} settle there.

es.L: las ciudades que Huram había dado a Salomón, Salomón las edificó, e hizo habitar allí a los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Salomón reconstruyó los pueblos que Huram le había dado y estableció en ellos a israelitas.
es.R: Entonces Salomón reconstruyó los pueblos que Huram le había dado, e hizo que se establecieran allí israelitas.

fr.L: les villes que Houram avait données à Salomon, Salomon les bâtit et y établit les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: Salomon rebâtit les villes que Houram lui avait données et y établit des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.
fr.R: Ensuite, Salomon a reconstruit les villes que Houram lui avait données, et il y a fait habiter des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.

sw.L: miji ambayo Huramu alikuwa amempa Sulemani, Sulemani akaijenga, akawakalisha humo wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Sulemani aliijenga upya miji ambayo Huramu alikuwa amempa, akawakalisha Waisraeli ndani yake.
sw.R: Kisha Sulemani akaijenga upya miji ambayo Huramu alikuwa amempa, akawaweka Waisraeli waishi humo.

vi.L: các thành mà Hu-ram đã ban cho Sa-lô-môn, thì Sa-lô-môn xây chúng, và cho con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên định cư ở đó.
vi.B: thì Sa-lô-môn xây lại các thành mà Hu-ram đã ban cho mình và cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên định cư tại đó.
vi.R: Rồi Sa-lô-môn xây lại các thành mà Hu-ram đã tặng vua, và cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đến sinh sống ở đó.

ko.L: 후람이 솔로몬에게 준 성읍들을 솔로몬이 지어서 거기에 이스라엘 자손을 살게 했다.
ko.B: 솔로몬은 후람이 그에게 준 성읍들을 다시 짓고 거기에 이스라엘 자손을 살게 했다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 솔로몬은 후람이 그에게 준 성읍들을 다시 지었다. 그리고 이스라엘 자손을 거기에 살게 했다.

pt.L: as cidades que Hurão tinha dado a Salomão, Salomão as construiu, e fez habitar ali os filhos de Israel.
pt.B: Salomão reconstruiu as cidades que Hurão lhe tinha dado e estabeleceu israelitas nelas.
pt.R: Depois Salomão reconstruiu as cidades que Hurão lhe tinha dado e fez israelitas irem morar nelas.

decisions.choice: the cities Huram had given to Solomon; 1 Kings 9:11-13 has Solomon giving Hiram twenty cities
alternatives: Solomon rebuilt the cities he had given to Huram (an emendation to match 1 Kings)
decisions.reason: In 1 Kings 9:11-13 Solomon gives Hiram twenty towns in Galilee, and Hiram scorns them. Here the towns are ones Huram gave to Solomon, and Solomon rebuilds them and settles Israelites in them. The two accounts may tell different sides of one exchange: the towns Hiram rejected came back to Solomon, who then built them up. Or they may describe a separate gift. The text does not say.

decisions.choice: Huram: Hiram king of Tyre
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells the king's name Huram (2:2, 10-11); 1 Kings spells it Hiram. It is the same man, Solomon's ally who supplied the timber for the temple.

decisions.choice: built: rebuilt and strengthened
decisions.reason: "Build" is used for rebuilding a town and for fortifying one, as in 1 Kings 9:17. Since the towns already stood, rebuilt is meant.

decisions.choice: towns; rebuilt
decisions.reason: "Towns" suits places of this size, as in 1 Kings 9:11, and "rebuilt" gives the sense of "built" here. Balanced and Readable say "him" for the repeated name Solomon.

decisions.choice: "xây lại" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The towns already stood; "built" here means rebuilt and strengthened (m3).

decisions.choice: Hurão
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells the king of Tyre's name Huram (m2), so Portuguese writes "Hurão", as the earlier chapters of this book do, with the ending of "Hirão", the form 1 Kings 5 and 9 use in Portuguese for the same man.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); israelitas (B, R); no gender span
alternatives: a gender span, as in the English
decisions.reason: As the Old Testament terms: "filhos" already takes in daughters and "israelitas" names men and women, so Portuguese needs no gender span; the same in verses 8 and 9.

source.text: וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ חֲמָ֣ת צוֹבָ֔ה וַיֶּחֱזַ֖ק עָלֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And went Solomon [to] Hamath-zobah and prevailed over it.

en.L: And Solomon went [to] Hamath-zobah and prevailed over it.
en.B: Solomon went to Hamath-zobah and seized it.
en.R: Solomon marched to Hamath-zobah and captured it.

es.L: Y fue Salomón [a] Hamat-soba y se apoderó de ella.
es.B: Salomón fue a Hamat-soba y la tomó.
es.R: Salomón marchó contra Hamat-soba y la conquistó.

fr.L: Et Salomon alla [à] Hamath-Soba et s’en rendit maître.
fr.B: Salomon marcha contre Hamath-Soba et s’en empara.
fr.R: Salomon est parti en guerre contre Hamath-Soba et il l’a prise.

sw.R: Sulemani aliongoza jeshi lake mpaka Hamath-soba, akauteka.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn đi [đến] Ha-mát Xô-ba và thắng được nó.
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn đi đến Ha-mát Xô-ba và chiếm lấy thành ấy.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn kéo quân đến Ha-mát Xô-ba và chiếm thành ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 하맛소바로 가서 그곳을 이겼다.

pt.L: E Salomão foi [a] Hamate-Zobá e prevaleceu sobre ela.
pt.B: Salomão foi a Hamate-Zobá e se apoderou dela.
pt.R: Salomão marchou contra Hamate-Zobá e a conquistou.

decisions.choice: Hamath-zobah: not in 1 Kings 9
decisions.reason: This verse has no parallel in 1 Kings. It is the only military campaign of Solomon's that the Bible records. It explains how Solomon came to build store cities "in Hamath" (verse 4).

decisions.choice: Hamath-zobah: Hamath, in or near the region of Zobah, north of Israel
decisions.reason: Hamath was a kingdom on the Orontes River in Syria, whose king made peace with David (1 Chronicles 18:9-10). Zobah was the Aramean kingdom David defeated (1 Chronicles 18:3). The joined name probably points to the land of Hamath bordering Zobah; it may also be one town called by both names.

decisions.choice: prevailed over it: took control of it
decisions.reason: The verb means "be strong"; with "over" it means to overpower or seize a place.

decisions.choice: marched to
decisions.reason: Readable says "marched" because the verb "went" here means going with an army, as "captured" shows.

decisions.choice: "Hamat-soba"
decisions.reason: The place joins Hamath and Zobah (meaning decision); Spanish joins the forms "Hamat" (Kings) and "Soba" (Samuel) with a hyphen.

decisions.choice: "Hamath-Soba"
decisions.reason: The two names in their French forms of these books, Hamath and Soba (2 Samuel 8:3, 9), joined as the Hebrew joins them.

decisions.choice: Hamath-soba
decisions.reason: The compound name is given as one, joining the Swahili forms of Hamath (Hamathi) and Zobah (Soba) in the shorter hyphenated form usual for compound place names (Lebo-hamathi, Beth-horoni).

decisions.choice: Hamate-Zobá
decisions.reason: The joined name (m2) puts together the forms of Hamate and Zobá that 1 Chronicles 18:3, 9 use in Portuguese.

source.text: וַיִּ֥בֶן אֶת־תַּדְמֹ֖ר בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְאֵת֙ כָּל־עָרֵ֣י הַֽמִּסְכְּנ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה בַּחֲמָֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness and all the cities of the stores which he built in Hamath.

en.L: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the cities of storage that he built in Hamath.
en.B: He built Tadmor in the wilderness and all the store cities that he built in Hamath.
en.R: He built Tadmor in the desert, and all the towns in the region of Hamath where he stored supplies.

es.L: Y edificó Tadmor en el desierto, y todas las ciudades de almacenes que edificó en Hamat.
es.B: Edificó Tadmor en el desierto y todas las ciudades de almacenes que edificó en Hamat.
es.R: Construyó Tadmor en el desierto, y todos los pueblos de la región de Hamat donde guardaba provisiones.

fr.L: Et il bâtit Tadmor dans le désert, et toutes les villes d’entrepôts qu’il bâtit en Hamath.
fr.B: Il bâtit Tadmor dans le désert et toutes les villes d’entrepôts qu’il bâtit dans la région de Hamath.
fr.R: Il a construit Tadmor dans le désert, et toutes les villes de la région de Hamath où il gardait ses provisions.

sw.L: Akaijenga Tadmori nyikani, na miji yote ya ghala aliyoijenga katika Hamathi.
sw.B: Alijenga Tadmori nyikani na miji yote ya ghala aliyoijenga katika Hamathi.
sw.R: Alijenga Tadmori jangwani, na miji yote katika eneo la Hamathi alimohifadhi mahitaji.

vi.L: Vua xây Tát-mốt trong hoang mạc, và tất cả các thành kho mà vua xây tại Ha-mát.
vi.B: Vua xây Tát-mốt trong hoang mạc và tất cả các thành kho vua xây tại Ha-mát.
vi.R: Vua xây Tát-mốt trong sa mạc, và tất cả các thành trong vùng Ha-mát để chứa lương thực và vật dụng.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 광야에 다드몰을 지었고, 하맛에 지은 모든 국고 성읍도 [지었다].
ko.B: 그는 광야에 다드몰을 짓고, 하맛 지방에 모든 국고 성읍을 지었다.
ko.R: 그는 사막에 다드몰을 지었다. 그리고 하맛 지방에 물자를 쌓아 두는 성읍들을 모두 지었다.

pt.L: E construiu Tadmor no deserto, e todas as cidades de armazenamento que construiu em Hamate.
pt.B: Ele construiu Tadmor no deserto e todas as cidades-armazéns que construiu em Hamate.
pt.R: Ele construiu Tadmor no deserto e todas as cidades da região de Hamate onde guardava mantimentos.

decisions.choice: Tadmor in the wilderness; 1 Kings 9:18 has Tamar in the wilderness, in the land
decisions.reason: The written text of 1 Kings 9:18 spells Tamar, a town on the southern edge of the land, though it is traditionally read aloud as Tadmor. Chronicles has Tadmor in its written text and drops "in the land". It also places the store cities "in Hamath", where 1 Kings 9:19 has store cities "that belonged to Solomon" (repeated here in verse 6).

decisions.choice: Tadmor: an oasis in the Syrian desert, later called Palmyra
decisions.reason: Tadmor lay in the desert northeast of Hamath, on the caravan road between Syria and the Euphrates. Building there fits the move into Hamath in verse 3.

decisions.choice: cities of storage: towns where grain and supplies were stored
decisions.reason: Royal store cities held food and supplies for the army and the court, like those Israel built for Pharaoh (Exodus 1:11).

decisions.choice: desert; towns ... where he stored supplies
decisions.reason: Readable says "desert" for wilderness and explains store cities, as in 1 Kings 9:18-19.

decisions.choice: "Tadmor"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has Tadmor where 1 Kings 9:18 has Tamar (meaning decision); Spanish keeps the name as the Hebrew gives it.

decisions.choice: "Tát-mốt"
decisions.reason: Chronicles reads Tadmor, the oasis later called Palmyra (m1, m2); it is kept apart from "Tát-mo", the Tamar of 1 Kings 9:18.

decisions.choice: "다드몰"; "국고 성읍" (L, B), "물자를 쌓아 두는 성읍" (R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles reads Tadmor where 1 Kings has Tamar (m1); "국고 성읍" as in 1 Kings 9:19.

decisions.choice: Tadmor; cidades de armazenamento (L), cidades-armazéns (B)
decisions.reason: Chronicles writes Tadmor (m1), the oasis later called Palmyra (m2), so Portuguese keeps "Tadmor" where 1 Kings 9:18 has "Tamar". The store cities keep the words of 1 Kings 9:19 and Exodus 1:11 in Portuguese.

source.text: וַיִּ֜בֶן אֶת־בֵּ֤ית חוֹרוֹן֙ הָֽעֶלְי֔וֹן וְאֶת־בֵּ֥ית חוֹר֖וֹן הַתַּחְתּ֑וֹן עָרֵ֣י מָצ֔וֹר חוֹמ֖וֹת דְּלָתַ֥יִם וּבְרִֽיחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he built Beth-horon the upper and Beth-horon the lower, cities of fortification, walls, doors and bar,

en.L: And he built Upper Beth-horon and Lower Beth-horon, fortified cities [with] walls, doors and bars,
en.B: He also built Upper Beth-horon and Lower Beth-horon as fortified towns, with walls, gates and bars,
en.R: He built up the towns of Upper Beth-horon and Lower Beth-horon and made them strong. He gave them walls, and gates with bars to lock them.

es.L: Y edificó Bet-horón la de arriba y Bet-horón la de abajo, ciudades fortificadas, [con] muros, puertas y cerrojos,
es.B: Edificó también Bet-horón la de arriba y Bet-horón la de abajo como ciudades fortificadas, con muros, puertas y cerrojos,
es.R: Reconstruyó los pueblos de Bet-horón la de arriba y Bet-horón la de abajo y los hizo fuertes. Les dio muros, y puertas con cerrojos para cerrarlas.

fr.L: Et il bâtit Beth-Horôn-le-Haut et Beth-Horôn-le-Bas, villes fortifiées [avec] murailles, portes et barres,
fr.B: Il bâtit aussi Beth-Horôn-le-Haut et Beth-Horôn-le-Bas, villes fortifiées avec murailles, portes et barres,
fr.R: Il a reconstruit les villes de Beth-Horôn-le-Haut et de Beth-Horôn-le-Bas, et il les a fortifiées. Il leur a donné des murailles, et des portes avec des barres pour les fermer.

sw.L: Akajenga Beth-horoni ya Juu na Beth-horoni ya Chini, miji yenye ngome, [yenye] kuta, milango na makomeo,
sw.B: Alijenga pia Beth-horoni ya Juu na Beth-horoni ya Chini kuwa miji yenye ngome, yenye kuta, malango na makomeo,
sw.R: Aliijenga upya miji ya Beth-horoni ya Juu na Beth-horoni ya Chini, akaifanya imara. Akaipa kuta, na malango yenye makomeo ya kuyafunga.

vi.L: Vua xây Bết-Hô-rôn Thượng và Bết-Hô-rôn Hạ, các thành kiên cố [có] tường, cửa và then,
vi.B: Vua cũng xây Bết-Hô-rôn Thượng và Bết-Hô-rôn Hạ thành những thành kiên cố, có tường, cổng và then cài,
vi.R: Vua xây thêm các thành Bết-Hô-rôn Thượng và Bết-Hô-rôn Hạ và làm cho chúng vững chắc. Vua xây tường và làm các cổng có then để cài lại.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 윗 벧호론과 아래 벧호론을 성벽과 문과 빗장이 있는 요새 성읍으로 지었고,
ko.B: 그는 또 윗 벧호론과 아래 벧호론을 성벽과 성문과 빗장을 갖춘 요새 성읍으로 지었고,
ko.R: 그는 윗 벧호론 성읍과 아래 벧호론 성읍을 튼튼하게 다시 지었다. 성벽을 쌓고, 빗장으로 잠그는 성문을 달았다.

pt.L: E construiu Bete-Horom de Cima e Bete-Horom de Baixo, cidades fortificadas, [com] muralhas, portas e trancas,
pt.B: Ele também construiu Bete-Horom de Cima e Bete-Horom de Baixo como cidades fortificadas, com muralhas, portões e trancas,
pt.R: Ele reconstruiu as cidades de Bete-Horom de Cima e Bete-Horom de Baixo e as tornou fortes. Deu a elas muralhas e portões com trancas para fechá-los.

decisions.choice: Upper and Lower Beth-horon; 1 Kings 9:17 names only Lower Beth-horon
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 9:17 lists Gezer and Lower Beth-horon. Chronicles does not name Gezer, adds Upper Beth-horon, and describes the towns' walls and gates.

decisions.choice: Beth-horon: two towns guarding the pass up from the coastal plain
decisions.reason: Upper and Lower Beth-horon stood on the main road from the coast to the hill country north of Jerusalem (Joshua 10:10-11; 16:3, 5).

decisions.choice: doors and bar: the two leaves of a city gate and the beam that locked them
decisions.reason: A city gate had two doors that were shut and held by a bar laid across them (Deuteronomy 3:5).

decisions.choice: the list runs on into verse 6

decisions.choice: gates and bars (Balanced); gates with bars to lock them (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Doors" of a city are its gates, so Balanced and Readable say "gates", and Readable says what the bars were for.

records.literal_gloss: and Baalath and all the cities of the stores which belonged to Solomon, and all the cities of the chariotry and the cities of the horsemen, and all the desire of Solomon which he desired to build in Jerusalem and in Lebanon and in all [the] land of his dominion.

en.L: and Baalath, and all the cities of storage that belonged to Solomon, and all the cities of the chariots and the cities of the horsemen, and all the desire of Solomon that he desired to build in Jerusalem and in Lebanon and in all the land of his dominion.
en.B: and Baalath, all the store cities that Solomon had, all the towns for his chariots and for his horsemen, and whatever Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and throughout all the land he ruled.

es.B: y Baalat, todas las ciudades de almacenes que tenía Salomón, todas las ciudades para sus carros y para sus jinetes, y todo lo que Salomón quiso edificar en Jerusalén, en el Líbano y en toda la tierra que gobernaba.
es.R: Construyó también Baalat, todos los pueblos donde guardaba provisiones, y todos los pueblos para sus carros y sus jinetes. Construyó todo lo que quiso en Jerusalén, en el Líbano y en todas partes de la tierra que gobernaba.

fr.B: ainsi que Baalath, toutes les villes d’entrepôts de Salomon, toutes les villes pour ses chars et pour ses cavaliers, et tout ce que Salomon voulut bâtir à Jérusalem, au Liban et dans tout le pays qu’il gouvernait.

vi.R: Vua cũng xây Ba-a-lát, tất cả các thành để chứa lương thực và vật dụng, và tất cả các thành cho xe chiến mã và kỵ binh của vua. Vua xây mọi thứ vua muốn xây tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, tại Li-ban và ở khắp nơi trong xứ vua cai trị.

ko.L: 바알랏과 솔로몬에게 속한 모든 국고 성읍과 모든 병거 성읍과 기병 성읍, 그리고 솔로몬이 예루살렘과 레바논과 그가 다스리는 온 땅에 짓고 싶어 한 모든 것을 [지었다].

ko.R: 또 바알랏 성읍을 지었고, 물자를 쌓아 두는 성읍들과 병거와 기병을 두는 성읍들도 모두 지었다. 그는 예루살렘과 레바논과 그가 다스리는 온 땅에 짓고 싶은 것은 무엇이든 지었다.

pt.B: e Baalate, todas as cidades-armazéns que Salomão tinha, todas as cidades para os seus carros e para os seus cavaleiros, e tudo o que Salomão quis construir em Jerusalém, no Líbano e em toda a terra que ele governava.
pt.R: Ele também construiu Baalate, todas as cidades onde guardava mantimentos e todas as cidades para os seus carros de guerra e os seus cavaleiros. Construiu tudo o que quis construir em Jerusalém, no Líbano e em toda a terra que governava.

decisions.choice: parallel to 1 Kings 9:18-19, with "all" added before the chariot cities and before Solomon's desire
decisions.reason: The verse follows 1 Kings 9:18-19 closely. Tamar has moved to verse 4 as Tadmor, and "all" is added twice. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: Baalath: a town in the territory of Dan
decisions.reason: Baalath is listed among Dan's towns (Joshua 19:44), not far from Beth-horon.

decisions.choice: horsemen: the men who rode or drove the horses, or the horses themselves
decisions.reason: The word can mean either. Solomon's chariots and horses are counted in 1:14.

decisions.choice: the desire of Solomon that he desired: whatever he set his heart on
decisions.reason: The noun and verb repeat one root: these were the projects Solomon wanted for himself (compare 7:11).

decisions.choice: whatever Solomon desired to build; the land he ruled
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 9:19, Balanced and Readable turn "the desire ... that he desired" into a plain clause, and "the land of his dominion" into "the land he ruled".

decisions.choice: todas as cidades dos carros; tudo o que Salomão desejou construir
decisions.reason: The Portuguese of 1 Kings 9:18-19 with "Baalate" and the two "all" Chronicles adds (m1).

en.L: All the people who were left of the Hittites and the Amorites and the Perizzites and the Hivites and the Jebusites, who [were] not of Israel,
en.B: As for all the people who were left of the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites, who were not part of Israel,
en.R: Some of the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites were still left in the land. These people were not part of Israel.

vi.R: Trong xứ vẫn còn sót lại một số người Hê-tít, A-mô-rít, Phê-rê-sít, Hê-vít và Giê-bu-sít. Những người này không phải là dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 헷 사람과 아모리 사람과 브리스 사람과 히위 사람과 여부스 사람 가운데 남은 모든 백성, 곧 이스라엘에 속하지 않은 자들,

pt.L: Todo o povo que tinha restado dos hititas, e dos amorreus, e dos ferezeus, e dos heveus, e dos jebuseus, que não [eram] de Israel,

decisions.choice: parallel to 1 Kings 9:20, with the Hittites named before the Amorites and "not of Israel" for "not of the sons of Israel"
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 1 Kings 9:20 with two small changes: the first two peoples change places, and "Israel" stands for "the sons of Israel". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, Jebusites: the peoples of Canaan before Israel
decisions.reason: These names belong to the standard list of the land's earlier inhabitants (Exodus 3:8; Deuteronomy 7:1; Joshua 9:1).

decisions.choice: all the people who were left: placed first and taken up again in verse 8
decisions.reason: The verse names the group, and verse 8 continues "from their descendants ... Solomon raised forced labor". The sentence ends there.

decisions.choice: two sentences
decisions.reason: Readable states who these peoples were in sentences of their own before verse 8 says what Solomon did with them, as in 1 Kings 9:20.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 9:20-23 through verse 10
decisions.reason: Verses 7-10 retell 1 Kings 9:20-23 (m1 of each verse); the Vietnamese of Kings is kept, changing only what Chronicles changes: the order of the peoples, "for his work", and 250 officers for 550.

decisions.choice: os hititas ... os amorreus; de Israel
decisions.reason: The names of Exodus 3:8 and 1 Kings 9:20 in Portuguese, in Chronicles' order, with the Hittites first, and "de Israel" for Kings' "dos filhos de Israel" (m1); Literal keeps the "e" before each people, as the Hebrew has it.

records.literal_gloss: of their sons who remained after them in the land whom not had destroyed them [the] sons of Israel, and raised them Solomon for forced labor until the day this.

en.L: of their {{gender:children|sons}} who were left after them in the land, whom the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel had not destroyed, Solomon raised them for forced labor, to this day.
en.B: from their descendants who were still left in the land, whom the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} had not destroyed, Solomon conscripted forced labor, to this day.
en.R: They were the descendants of the peoples the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} had not destroyed. Solomon made them do forced labor, as they still do to this day.

es.L: de sus hijos que quedaron después de ellos en la tierra, a quienes los hijos de Israel no habían destruido, Salomón los reclutó para trabajo forzado, hasta el día de hoy.
es.B: a sus descendientes que todavía quedaban en el país, a quienes los israelitas no habían destruido, Salomón los reclutó como trabajadores forzados, hasta el día de hoy.
es.R: Eran descendientes de los pueblos que los israelitas no habían destruido. Salomón los obligó a hacer trabajos forzados, como siguen haciéndolo hasta el día de hoy.

fr.L: d’entre leurs {{gender:enfants|fils}} qui étaient restés après eux dans le pays, que les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël n’avaient pas détruits, Salomon les leva pour la corvée, jusqu’à ce jour.
fr.B: parmi leurs descendants qui restaient encore dans le pays, et que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} n’avaient pas détruits, Salomon leva des hommes pour la corvée, jusqu’à aujourd’hui.

sw.L: wana wao waliosalia baada yao katika nchi, ambao wana wa Israeli hawakuwaangamiza, Sulemani akawaandikisha kwa kazi ya kulazimishwa, mpaka siku hii ya leo.
sw.B: wazao wao waliosalia katika nchi, ambao Waisraeli hawakuwaangamiza, Sulemani aliwaandikisha kwa kazi ya kulazimishwa, mpaka leo.

vi.L: con cháu của họ còn sót lại sau họ trong xứ, là những người mà con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên đã không tiêu diệt, thì Sa-lô-môn bắt họ làm lao dịch cho đến ngày nay.
vi.B: tức là con cháu họ còn sót lại trong xứ, những người mà dân Y-sơ-ra-ên không tiêu diệt, thì Sa-lô-môn trưng tập họ làm lao dịch cho đến ngày nay.
vi.R: Họ là con cháu của những dân mà người Y-sơ-ra-ên đã không tiêu diệt. Sa-lô-môn bắt họ làm lao dịch, và cho đến ngày nay họ vẫn làm như vậy.

ko.L: 곧 이스라엘 자손이 멸하지 못하여 그들의 뒤를 이어 그 땅에 남은 그들의 자손을, 솔로몬이 강제 노역에 징발했다. 오늘날까지 그러하다.
ko.B: 곧 이스라엘 자손이 멸하지 못하여 그 땅에 남아 있던 그들의 자손을 솔로몬은 강제 노역에 징발했다. 오늘날까지 그러하다.
ko.R: 그들은 이스라엘 자손이 없애지 못한 민족들의 자손이었다. 솔로몬은 그들에게 억지로 일을 시켰는데, 오늘날까지 그렇게 일하고 있다.

pt.L: dos filhos deles, que tinham restado depois deles na terra, os quais os filhos de Israel não tinham destruído, Salomão os levantou para trabalho forçado, até este dia.
pt.B: dentre os descendentes deles que ainda tinham ficado na terra e que os israelitas não tinham destruído, Salomão recrutou trabalhadores forçados, até o dia de hoje.
pt.R: Eram os descendentes dos povos que os israelitas não tinham destruído. Salomão os obrigou a fazer trabalho forçado, e eles continuam assim até o dia de hoje.

decisions.choice: parallel to 1 Kings 9:21, with "destroyed" for "been able to devote to destruction" and without "as slaves"
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 9:21 says Israel "had not been able to devote them to destruction" and that Solomon raised them "for forced labor of slaving". Chronicles says simply that Israel "had not destroyed them" and that Solomon raised them "for forced labor". It also begins "from their descendants", that is, the workers were drawn from among them. The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: forced labor: workers called up by the king to work without pay
decisions.reason: Kings conscripted men for their building works (1 Kings 5:27-28; 9:15). Verse 9 says that Israelites were not made slaves for this work.

decisions.choice: to this day: the words of the earlier account
decisions.reason: The phrase comes over from 1 Kings 9:21, where it means the time of that writer, while the kingdom of Judah still stood. Chronicles keeps the words of its source, as at 5:9; by its own time, after the exile, no king of Israel ruled to raise forced labor.

decisions.choice: conscripted
decisions.reason: The verb is "raised" or "brought up", used of calling up a workforce, as in 1 Kings 9:21; Balanced says what it means.

decisions.choice: "sus hijos", "los hijos de Israel" (L); "sus descendientes", "los israelitas" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 1 Kings 9:20-21: the Spanish words already take in women, so the English gender span has no counterpart.

decisions.choice: "강제 노역" (L, B), "억지로 일을 시켰다" (R); "오늘날까지"
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 9:21, without "as slaves", which Chronicles does not have (m1).

decisions.choice: não tinham destruído; trabalho forçado (no "escravos")
alternatives: não tinham podido consagrar à destruição ... de escravos (1 Kings 9:21)
decisions.reason: Chronicles says simply "destroyed" and has no "as slaves" (m1), so the Portuguese of 1 Kings 9:21 drops "consagrar à destruição" and "escravos" and keeps the rest.

source.text: וּמִן־בְּנֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא־נָתַ֧ן שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה לַעֲבָדִ֖ים לִמְלַאכְתּ֑וֹ כִּי־הֵ֜מָּה אַנְשֵׁ֤י מִלְחָמָה֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י שָׁלִישָׁ֔יו וְשָׂרֵ֥י רִכְבּ֖וֹ וּפָרָשָֽׁיו׃פ

records.literal_gloss: But of [the] sons of Israel, whom not made Solomon into slaves for his work, for they [were] men of war and commanders of his officers and commanders of his chariotry and his horsemen.

en.L: But of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel Solomon did not make [any] slaves for his work; for they [were] men of war, and commanders of his officers, and commanders of his chariots and his horsemen.
en.B: But Solomon did not make slaves of any of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} for his work. They were his soldiers, the commanders of his officers, and the commanders of his chariots and his horsemen.
en.R: But Solomon did not make any of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} work for him as slaves. Instead, they served as his soldiers and his chief officers, and they commanded his chariots and his horsemen.

es.L: Pero de los hijos de Israel Salomón no hizo esclavos para su obra, porque ellos [eran] hombres de guerra, y jefes de sus oficiales, y jefes de sus carros y de sus jinetes.
es.B: Pero Salomón no hizo esclavo a ninguno de los israelitas para su obra. Ellos eran sus soldados, los jefes de sus oficiales y los jefes de sus carros y de sus jinetes.
es.R: Pero Salomón no obligó a ninguno de los israelitas a trabajar para él como esclavo. Ellos le servían como soldados y como oficiales principales, y mandaban sus carros y sus jinetes.

fr.L: Mais des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, Salomon ne fit pas d’esclaves pour son ouvrage ; car ils [étaient] des hommes de guerre, et les chefs de ses officiers, et les chefs de ses chars et de ses cavaliers.
fr.B: Mais Salomon ne fit esclave aucun des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} pour son ouvrage. Ils étaient ses soldats, les chefs de ses officiers, et les chefs de ses chars et de ses cavaliers.
fr.R: Mais Salomon n’a obligé aucun des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} à travailler pour lui comme esclave. Ils lui servaient de soldats et d’officiers supérieurs, et ils dirigeaient ses chars et ses cavaliers.

sw.L: Lakini katika wana wa Israeli Sulemani hakumfanya mtu kuwa mtumwa kwa kazi yake; kwa maana wao [walikuwa] watu wa vita, na wakuu wa maafisa wake, na wakuu wa magari yake ya vita na wapanda farasi wake.
sw.B: Lakini Sulemani hakumfanya mtumwa yeyote wa Waisraeli kwa kazi yake. Wao walikuwa askari wake, wakuu wa maafisa wake, na wakuu wa magari yake ya vita na wapanda farasi wake.
sw.R: Lakini Sulemani hakumfanya Mwisraeli yeyote kumfanyia kazi kama mtumwa. Badala yake walitumika kama askari wake na maafisa wake wakuu, nao waliongoza magari yake ya vita na wapanda farasi wake.

vi.L: Nhưng Sa-lô-môn không bắt ai trong con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên làm nô lệ cho công việc của vua; vì họ [là] quân lính, các quan chỉ huy của các sĩ quan vua, và các chỉ huy xe chiến mã và kỵ binh của vua.
vi.B: Nhưng Sa-lô-môn không bắt người Y-sơ-ra-ên nào làm nô lệ cho công việc của vua. Họ là binh lính, tướng chỉ huy các sĩ quan của vua, và chỉ huy các đội xe chiến mã và kỵ binh của vua.
vi.R: Nhưng Sa-lô-môn không bắt người Y-sơ-ra-ên nào làm nô lệ cho mình. Thay vào đó, họ phục vụ vua làm binh lính và sĩ quan cao cấp, và họ chỉ huy các đội xe chiến mã và kỵ binh của vua.

ko.L: 그러나 이스라엘 자손 가운데서는 솔로몬이 자기 일을 위하여 노예를 삼지 않았다. 그들은 군사들과 그의 장교들의 지휘관들과 그의 병거와 기병의 지휘관들이었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러나 솔로몬은 이스라엘 자손은 아무도 노예로 삼아 자기 일을 시키지 않았다. 그들은 그의 군사들이었고, 장교들을 거느린 지휘관들이었으며, 병거와 기병을 지휘하는 사람들이었다.
ko.R: 그러나 솔로몬은 이스라엘 자손은 한 사람도 노예로 삼아 일을 시키지 않았다. 그 대신 그들은 그의 군사와 높은 장교로 일했고, 그의 병거와 기병을 지휘했다.

pt.L: Mas dos filhos de Israel Salomão não fez [nenhum] escravo para a sua obra; pois eles [eram] homens de guerra, e chefes dos seus capitães, e chefes dos seus carros e dos seus cavaleiros.
pt.B: Mas Salomão não fez escravo nenhum dos israelitas para a sua obra. Eles eram os seus soldados, os comandantes dos seus capitães e os comandantes dos seus carros e dos seus cavaleiros.
pt.R: Mas Salomão não obrigou nenhum israelita a trabalhar para ele como escravo. Em vez disso, eles serviam como os seus soldados e os seus oficiais principais, e comandavam os seus carros de guerra e os seus cavaleiros.

decisions.choice: parallel to 1 Kings 9:22, with "for his work" added and a shorter list of ranks
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 9:22 lists "the men of war, his servants, his commanders, his officers, and the commanders of his chariots and his horsemen". Chronicles adds "for his work", leaves out "his servants", and has "commanders of his officers" where Kings has "his commanders and his officers".

decisions.choice: whom Solomon did not make slaves: the main statement of the sentence
decisions.reason: The Hebrew begins "but of the sons of Israel, whom Solomon did not make slaves", leaving the sentence open; the sense is that he made none of them slaves.

decisions.choice: officers: a rank in the army
decisions.reason: The word comes from "three" and may first have meant the third man in a chariot. It came to name a high-ranking officer (1 Kings 9:22; 2 Kings 9:25).

decisions.choice: slaves
decisions.reason: "Slave" is kept at every level, as in 1 Kings 9:22, because the verse is about who was made a slave.

decisions.choice: soldiers; chief officers (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Men of war" is plain "soldiers", and Readable says "chief officers" for "commanders of his officers".

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" at every level
decisions.reason: Here slavery itself is meant, so "nô lệ" stands at every level, as in 1 Kings 9:22; it is not the honored "đầy tớ" of God's servants.

decisions.choice: escravo (every level); chefes (L), comandantes (B) dos seus capitães
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 9:22 in Portuguese: "escravo" at every level, since the verse is about who was made a slave, and "capitães" for the high army rank (m3); Chronicles' shorter list and "para a sua obra" (m1) are followed.

source.text: וְאֵ֨לֶּה שָׂרֵ֤י הַנִּצָּבִ֛יםאֲשֶׁר־לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם הָרֹדִ֖ים בָּעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And these [were] [the] chiefs of the officers who [belonged] to the king Solomon, fifty and two hundred, who ruled over the people.

en.L: And these [were] the chiefs of the officers who belonged to King Solomon: 250, who ruled over the people.
en.B: These were King Solomon's chief officers: 250 of them, who directed the people.
en.R: King Solomon had 250 chief officers. They directed the people who did the work.

es.L: Y estos [eran] los jefes de los oficiales del rey Salomón: doscientos cincuenta, que mandaban sobre el pueblo.
es.B: Estos eran los oficiales principales del rey Salomón: doscientos cincuenta, que dirigían al pueblo.
es.R: El rey Salomón tenía doscientos cincuenta oficiales principales. Ellos dirigían a la gente que hacía el trabajo.

fr.L: Et voici les chefs des intendants qui [étaient] au roi Salomon : 250, qui commandaient au peuple.
fr.B: Voici les chefs des intendants du roi Salomon : ils étaient 250, et dirigeaient le peuple.
fr.R: Le roi Salomon avait 250 chefs responsables. Ils dirigeaient ceux qui faisaient le travail.

sw.L: Na hawa [ndio waliokuwa] wakuu wa maafisa wa mfalme Sulemani: 250, waliowatawala watu.
sw.B: Hawa ndio waliokuwa maafisa wakuu wa mfalme Sulemani: 250, waliowaongoza watu.
sw.R: Mfalme Sulemani alikuwa na maafisa wakuu 250. Waliwaongoza watu walioifanya kazi.

vi.L: Đây [là] các trưởng quan của vua Sa-lô-môn: 250 người, điều khiển dân chúng.
vi.B: Đây là các quan chỉ huy trưởng của vua Sa-lô-môn: 250 người, điều khiển dân chúng.
vi.R: Vua Sa-lô-môn có 250 quan chỉ huy trưởng. Họ điều khiển những người làm việc.

ko.L: 그리고 이들은 솔로몬 왕에게 속한 관리들의 우두머리로서 250명이었는데, 백성을 다스렸다.
ko.B: 솔로몬 왕의 감독관은 250명이었는데, 그들이 백성을 지휘했다.
ko.R: 솔로몬 왕에게는 감독관이 250명 있었다. 그들이 일하는 사람들을 지휘했다.

pt.L: E estes [eram] os chefes dos oficiais que [pertenciam] ao rei Salomão: duzentos e cinquenta, que mandavam no povo.
pt.B: Estes eram os oficiais principais do rei Salomão: duzentos e cinquenta deles, que dirigiam o povo.
pt.R: O rei Salomão tinha duzentos e cinquenta oficiais principais. Eles dirigiam as pessoas que faziam o trabalho.

decisions.choice: 250 chief officers; 1 Kings 9:23 has 550
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 9:23 counts 550 chief officers "over the work", with 3,300 officials over the workers in 1 Kings 5:30. Chronicles counts 250 here and 3,600 overseers in 2:17. The numbers likely count different ranks; both books give the same total, 3,850 (3,300 and 550; 3,600 and 250). Chronicles also says the officers "belonged to King Solomon" where Kings says they were "over the work for Solomon".

decisions.choice: officers: the word as read aloud
decisions.reason: The written consonants and the traditional reading spell this word slightly differently. Both forms come from the verb "to stand, be stationed" and name officials stationed over others, like Solomon's district officers (1 Kings 4:5, 7). The sense is not affected.

decisions.choice: ruled over the people: directed the workforce
decisions.reason: The verb is used of masters over workers and need not mean harshness, though it can (Leviticus 25:43). "The people" here are the workers of verses 8-9.

decisions.choice: directed; the people who did the work (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Directed" gives the supervising sense without the overtones of "ruled", as in 1 Kings 9:23. Readable adds "who did the work" to show who "the people" were.

decisions.choice: "doscientos cincuenta"
decisions.reason: Chronicles counts 250 where 1 Kings 9:23 has 550 (meaning decision); the number is written in words, as the Spanish of 1 Kings 9:23 does.

decisions.choice: duzentos e cinquenta; mandavam (L), dirigiam (B, R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 9:23 in Portuguese, the round number in words and "mandar" / "dirigir" for the verb; Chronicles counts 250 where Kings has 550 (m1).

records.literal_gloss: And [the] daughter of Pharaoh brought up Solomon from [the] city of David to the house which he had built for her, for he said, Not shall dwell a wife of mine in [the] house of David king of Israel, for holiness [are] they where has come to them [the] ark of Yahweh.

en.L: And Solomon brought the daughter of Pharaoh up from the city of David to the house that he had built for her, for he said, "A wife of mine shall not live in the house of David king of Israel, for they [are] holy, [the places] to which the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has come."
en.B: Solomon moved Pharaoh's daughter up from the city of David to the house he had built for her. His reason was this: "No wife of mine is to live in the house of David king of Israel, since the places where the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has come are holy."
en.R: Solomon moved Pharaoh's daughter out of the city of David and into the palace he had built for her. He said, "No wife of mine may live in the palace of David, the king of Israel. The ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has been in those places, so they are holy."

es.L: Y a la hija del faraón la hizo subir Salomón de la ciudad de David a la casa que le había edificado, porque dijo: «No habitará mujer mía en la casa de David, rey de Israel, porque santos [son los lugares] adonde ha entrado el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».
es.B: Salomón trasladó a la hija del faraón de la ciudad de David a la casa que le había edificado. Su razón fue esta: «Ninguna mujer mía vivirá en la casa de David, rey de Israel, porque los lugares adonde ha llegado el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} son santos».
es.R: Salomón sacó a la hija del faraón de la ciudad de David y la llevó al palacio que le había construido. Dijo: «Ninguna esposa mía puede vivir en el palacio de David, el rey de Israel. El arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ha estado en esos lugares, y por eso son santos».

fr.L: Et Salomon fit monter la fille de Pharaon de la cité de David dans la maison qu’il lui avait bâtie, car il disait : « Une femme à moi n’habitera pas dans la maison de David, roi d’Israël, car ils [sont] saints, [les lieux] où est entrée l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: Salomon fit monter la fille de Pharaon de la cité de David dans la maison qu’il lui avait bâtie. Il en donnait cette raison : « Aucune de mes femmes ne doit habiter dans la maison de David, roi d’Israël, car les lieux où est entrée l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sont saints. »
fr.R: Salomon a fait quitter à la fille de Pharaon la cité de David pour l’installer dans le palais qu’il avait construit pour elle. Il disait : « Aucune de mes femmes ne doit habiter dans le palais de David, le roi d’Israël. L’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est entrée dans ces lieux, alors ils sont saints. »

sw.L: Sulemani akampandisha binti Farao kutoka mji wa Daudi mpaka nyumba aliyokuwa amemjengea, kwa maana alisema, "Mke wangu hatakaa katika nyumba ya Daudi mfalme wa Israeli, kwa maana [mahali] ambapo sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} limefika ni patakatifu."
sw.B: Sulemani alimhamisha binti Farao kutoka mji wa Daudi mpaka nyumba aliyokuwa amemjengea. Sababu yake ilikuwa hii: "Hakuna mke wangu atakayeishi katika nyumba ya Daudi mfalme wa Israeli, kwa kuwa mahali ambapo sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} limefika ni patakatifu."
sw.R: Sulemani alimhamisha binti Farao kutoka mji wa Daudi, akampeleka kwenye ikulu aliyokuwa amemjengea. Alisema, "Hakuna mke wangu atakayeishi katika ikulu ya Daudi, mfalme wa Israeli. Sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} limekuwa mahali hapo, kwa hiyo ni patakatifu."

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn đưa con gái Pha-ra-ôn từ thành Đa-vít lên cung mà vua đã xây cho nàng, vì vua nói: "Vợ của ta sẽ không được ở trong cung của Đa-vít vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, vì [những nơi] mà hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đến đều thánh."
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn dời con gái Pha-ra-ôn từ thành Đa-vít lên cung vua đã xây cho nàng. Vua giải thích: "Vợ của ta không được ở trong cung của Đa-vít vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, vì những nơi hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đến đều là thánh."
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn dời con gái Pha-ra-ôn ra khỏi thành Đa-vít đến cung điện vua đã xây cho nàng. Vua nói: "Vợ của ta không được ở trong cung điện của Đa-vít, vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ở những nơi ấy, nên những nơi ấy là thánh."

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 바로의 딸을 다윗 성에서 그가 그를 위하여 지은 집으로 데려왔다. 그가 말하기를 "내 아내가 이스라엘 왕 다윗의 집에 살아서는 안 된다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤가 들어온 곳들은 거룩하기 때문이다" 했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 솔로몬은 바로의 딸을 다윗 성에서 자기가 지어 준 궁으로 옮겨 오게 했다. 그가 이렇게 말했기 때문이다. "내 아내라도 이스라엘 왕 다윗의 궁에 살아서는 안 된다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤가 들어온 곳들은 거룩하다."
ko.R: 솔로몬은 바로의 딸을 다윗 성에서 데리고 나와, 자기가 지어 준 궁으로 옮겨 오게 했다. 그가 말했다. "내 아내라도 이스라엘 왕 다윗의 궁에서 살면 안 된다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤가 그곳들에 있었으니, 그곳들은 거룩하다."

pt.L: E Salomão fez subir a filha de Faraó da Cidade de Davi para a casa que tinha construído para ela, pois disse: "Uma mulher minha não morará na casa de Davi, rei de Israel, porque eles [são] santos, [os lugares] aos quais a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} chegou."
pt.B: Salomão mudou a filha de Faraó da Cidade de Davi para a casa que tinha construído para ela. O motivo era este: "Nenhuma mulher minha deve morar na casa de Davi, rei de Israel, pois os lugares onde a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} esteve são santos."
pt.R: Salomão tirou a filha de Faraó da Cidade de Davi e a levou para o palácio que tinha construído para ela. Ele disse: "Nenhuma mulher minha pode morar no palácio de Davi, o rei de Israel. A arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} esteve nesses lugares, por isso eles são santos."

decisions.choice: Solomon brought Pharaoh's daughter up, and why; 1 Kings 9:24 says only that she went up
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 9:24 says that Pharaoh's daughter went up from the city of David to her house, and that Solomon then built the Millo. Chronicles makes Solomon the one who moved her, gives his reason, and does not mention the Millo. It also has not told of the marriage itself, which 1 Kings 3:1 and 7:8 describe; it assumes the reader knows it.

decisions.choice: the places the ark has come to are holy
decisions.reason: The ark, the sign of the LORD's presence, had been kept in the city of David in the tent David pitched for it (1 Chronicles 15:1; 16:1; 2 Chronicles 5:2). Solomon judged that the places near where it had stood shared its holiness. The text does not say whether the problem was that she was a foreigner, that she was a woman, or simply that a household should not live there; it states only the holiness of the places.

decisions.choice: they: the buildings of David's house and the places around it
decisions.reason: "They" is plural and refers to the places the ark had come to, which include the house of David just named.

decisions.choice: the house of David: David's palace in the old city
decisions.reason: David had built himself a house in the city of David (1 Chronicles 14:1; 15:1), on the lower ridge south of the temple.

decisions.choice: The ark of the LORD has been in those places, so they are holy.
decisions.reason: Readable splits the reason into a separate sentence and puts the cause first.

decisions.choice: a filha de Faraó; a Cidade de Davi; fez subir (L), mudou (B), tirou ... e a levou (R)
decisions.reason: The names keep the forms of 1 Kings 9:24 in Portuguese ("Faraó" as a name, "a Cidade de Davi"); Chronicles makes Solomon the one who moves her (m1), so the verb is his.

en.B: Then Solomon presented burnt offerings to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s altar, which he had built in front of the porch,

es.B: Entonces Salomón presentó holocaustos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} sobre el altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que había edificado delante del pórtico,
es.R: Entonces Salomón ofreció holocaustos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} sobre el altar que había construido para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} delante del pórtico del templo.

fr.L: Alors Salomon offrit des holocaustes {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} sur l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qu’il avait bâti devant le vestibule,
fr.B: Alors Salomon offrit des holocaustes {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} sur l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qu’il avait bâti devant le vestibule,
fr.R: Alors Salomon a offert des holocaustes {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} sur l’autel qu’il avait construit pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} devant le vestibule du temple.

vi.B: Bấy giờ Sa-lô-môn dâng các của lễ thiêu lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trên bàn thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà vua đã xây phía trước tiền sảnh,
